limit_order_match_in_progress.meaning: a limit order matching (partial or full) is being processed through _processLimitBidOrder or _processLimitAskOrder
limit_order_match_in_progress.checkpoint: before the zero-cost check during limit order matching

matched_base_amount.meaning: matched base amount of the limit order match
matched_base_amount.checkpoint: before the zero-cost check during limit order matching

matched_quote_amount.meaning: matched quote amount of the limit order match
matched_quote_amount.checkpoint: before the zero-cost check during limit order matching

matched_amounts_bitwise_and.meaning: bitwise AND of matched base amount and matched quote amount; zero exactly when the two amounts have no overlapping 1-bits
matched_amounts_bitwise_and.checkpoint: derived from matched base and quote amounts before the zero-cost check

zero_cost_rejection_occurred.meaning: the legitimate limit order match was rejected as a zero-cost trade
zero_cost_rejection_occurred.checkpoint: at the zero-cost check during limit order matching

legitimate_trade_failed_misleading_error.meaning: legitimate trades fail with a misleading error, damaging user experience and market efficiency
legitimate_trade_failed_misleading_error.checkpoint: after the zero-cost check during limit order matching

assumptions: The zero-cost check is evaluated during limit order matching before the trade completes.
Matched base and quote amounts are observable quantities of the match at the zero-cost check.

unresolved.description: The report states the matched amounts have no overlapping 1-bits but does not quote the exact zero-cost check expression; the bitwise-AND relation is encoded via a derived product placeholder and requires review against the actual check.

limitations: Caller identity and authorization for triggering limit order matching are not stated in the report.
Whether matched amounts are caller-supplied inputs or derived from order state is not specified.
The exact zero-cost check expression and its operands are not fully quoted in prose.
